crossRefs.note: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

people.name: Acco
people.line: A seaport in Asher, also called Ptolemais.

people.name: Achzib
people.line: A coastal town allotted to Asher.

people.name: Ahlab
people.line: A Canaanite city allotted to Asher.

people.name: Aphek
people.line: A city in the territory of Asher.

people.name: Asher
people.line: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher

people.name: Helbah
people.line: Canaanite town not conquered by the tribe of Asher

translations.web: Asher didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Acco, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob;
translations.bsb: Asher failed to drive out the inhabitants of Acco, Sidon, Ahlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphik, and Rehob.
translations.kjv: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:
translations.asv: Asher drove not out the inhabitants of Acco, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob;
